description: A Kotlin class implementing the Checkout activity for an Android application, responsible for managing the checkout UI, form inputs, coupon application, payment method selection, and order submission logic.

classes.name: CheckoutActivity
classes.description: An Android activity managing the checkout process, including user input forms, coupon handling, payment method selection, and order submission.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, setting up UI components, binding view model, and setting listeners.

methods.name: setupToolbar
methods.description: Configures the activity's toolbar, including title and back navigation.

methods.name: setupPaymentMethodUi
methods.description: Sets up the UI elements for selecting payment methods based on current view model state.

methods.name: setupFormListeners
methods.description: Adds text change listeners to form fields and button click listeners, also manages payment method selection.

methods.name: setupCouponSuggestions
methods.description: Initializes coupon code suggestion dropdown and click handling.

methods.name: bindState
methods.description: Launches coroutines to observe view model state flows and update the UI accordingly.

methods.name: setLoading
methods.description: Enables/disables UI components to indicate loading state.

methods.name: setAllEnabled
methods.description: Recursively enables or disables a view and its children.

methods.name: showManageSavedCouponsDialog
methods.description: Displays a dialog to manage saved coupons with options to select or remove coupons.
